fieldValues.title: Work on one aspect of a large body of meaning cannot stay inside a boundary
fieldValues.statement: When I work on one aspect of a large repository such as muSrs, I draw a boundary around the concepts and actions I am working with and want every search and read to stay inside it. Today a container bounds a content search, but other reads are global, a boundary is made by hand, and nothing tells me when a large boundary has become slow.
